en.headline: 91-year-old man confirmed with locally acquired rat hepatitis E
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the Kowloon City care-home resident has been discharged, and a Homantin Plaza restaurant with rodent traces is being prosecuted.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Friday it is investigating a locally acquired human infection of rat hepatitis E virus involving a 91-year-old man with underlying illnesses, the third such case recorded in Hong Kong this year.

The man, who lives in a residential care home for the elderly in Kowloon City district, was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 16 September with fever and weakness in his limbs. Routine blood tests showed abnormal liver function, and a sample later tested positive for rat hepatitis E. The centre said his symptoms were relatively mild and he was discharged on 21 September after treatment.

He had no travel during the incubation period and no reported direct contact with rodents. The centre said it could not rule out indirect exposure to an environment or food contaminated by rodents or their droppings. Relatives, other residents and staff have no symptoms and are under medical surveillance.

Besides meals at the home, the man ate at a restaurant in Homantin Plaza once or twice a week with family. Inspectors from the centre and the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department found poor hygiene and rodent traces at the restaurant. The department has begun a prosecution under the Food Business Regulation and will issue a vermin-elimination notice. Investigations into the source of infection continue.

zh.headline: 九龍城安老院91歲院友確診大鼠戊肝 屬本地感染
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指患者已出院，何文田廣場一間食肄發現鼠跡，食環署已對負責人提出檢控。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周五表示，正調查一宗人類感染大鼠戊型肝炎的本地個案，患者為一名有長期病患的91歲男子，是本港今年第三宗大鼠戊肝個案。
該名男子居於九龍城區一間安老院，9月16日因發燒及四肢乏力被送往伊利沙伯醫院急症室，常規驗血發現肝功能異常，其後血液樣本對大鼠戊型肝炎呈陽性。中心指他症狀相對輕微，情況一直穩定，經治療後已於9月21日出院。
患者潛伏期內沒有外遊，亦沒有直接接觸鼠隻的紀錄，中心不排除他曾間接接觸受老鼠或其排泄物污染的地方或食物。病人家人、院舍其他院友及職員目前沒有病徵，正接受醫學監察。
除院舍膳食外，病人每周由家人陪同到何文田廣場一間食肄用膳一至兩次。中心與食環署巡查後，發現該食肄衞生欠佳並有鼠跡。食環署已根據《食物業規例》提出檢控，並會發出消滅蟲鼠通知。感染源頭仍在調查。
